Canada deported 3,323 Indians in first six months of 2026

Canada deported 3,323 Indian nationals in the first half of 2026, a figure that places the country on pace to exceed previous annual deportation records. This number represents nearly 88% of the total deportations recorded in 2025. Deportations were primarily due to non-compliance with immigration rules, rejected asylum claims, visa overstays, and visa fraud. Indians constituted the largest nationality among those removed from Canada during this period.
